headline: DFlash reports parallel diffusion drafting for multi-fold speculative decoding speedups
summary: DFlash uses a small block-diffusion model to draft multiple tokens in parallel, conditioned on hidden features extracted from a frozen autoregressive target model and injected into the drafter's key/value cache. The ICML 2026 paper reports lossless speculative decoding speedups on selected Qwen3 and Llama models and math, coding and chat workloads; on Qwen3 4B/8B it reports 4.91×/4.86× average speedup at temperature 0 and 4.24×/4.03× at temperature 1 on H200 GPUs. These are author-reported measurements, not an independent reproduction or fleet-throughput result. The paper provides code and checkpoint links, and a public repository describes further serving integrations that were not tested here.
